thread:
zoe_sales: Orbitrek CTO just escalated. Private POC (eu-central) showing sustained throughput drop after ~1h. If we can't stabilize in 4h they'll request an exec touchpoint. @mark_se can you share quick repro? :warning:
mark_se: Private bundle on 3x A100s, workload = mixed chat + embeddings, batch sizes varied. Repro: steady 320 rps -> 250 rps after 60m, p95 climbs to ~450ms. Logs show kvcache evictions and occasional TLS handshake retries to customer KMS. Snippet below.
mark_se: log:
```
2026-04-01T11:07:02Z runtime: kvcache eviction_ratio=0.28 threshold=0.12
2026-04-01T11:07:05Z network: tls handshake retry to kms-host=orbit-kms.local
2026-04-01T11:07:06Z runtime: enqueue batch size=64 latency=24ms
```
rafa_runtime: High eviction ratio + TLS retries suggests cache thrash plus intermittent KMS stalls. Could be customer proxy dropping connections under load. I'll check host drivers and kernel nvlink counters too.
ela_infra: Which image? If customer AMI patched their NIC drivers recently, we could see packet drops. Also spinning a hosted parity cluster now for fallback testing. Opening INF-9512.
mark_se: Image = rwi-private-2026-03-10. Orbitrek uses an inline TLS proxy for KMS. They insist keys stay in their VPC.
sana_ciso: Orbitrek's security asks for a KMS flow diagram and confirmation we never persist plaintext outside HSM. I'll draft and share; also they want 90-day KMS audit logs.
tara_support: Quick mitigation: (1) temporarily reduce embedding cache TTL to reduce evictions, (2) offer a hosted-run parity test (no key material moved if we use audit relay), (3) request short maintenance window to patch drivers if needed.
rafa_runtime: I can push a conservative cache policy now and run a smoke test. If behavior improves we can isolate KMS proxy as the culprit. ETA ~30m for config roll + smoke.
ela_infra: INF-9512 opened and hosted parity cluster warming in eu-central (ETA 40m). Notifying oncall.
deploy-bot: Job created by rafa_runtime: emb-cache-conservative -> private-eu-central -> apply. Status: queued.
rafa_runtime: Smoke after cache tweak: private improved from 250 -> 305 rps, p95 reduced to ~210ms. Hosted parity run shows baseline 320 rps p95=190ms. Still slightly below baseline but within 5-10%.
zoe_sales: I'll offer hosted-parity test to Orbitrek CTO and ask for short written approval for a hosted-relay if needed. Also confirm they'd consider reserved capacity pricing for production.
sana_ciso: Compliance packet prepared: SOC2 summary + KMS flow diagram + audit retention note. Sharing with legal.
tara_support: If Orbitrek approves hosted-relay we will document transit and get written consent. Runbook prepared.
ela_infra: ETA updates: hosted cluster ready in ~35m, driver patch standing by if parity not achieved.
zoe_sales: Scheduling exec sync at 19:30 CET to present numbers and next steps (short-term cache + network debugging, long-term reserved pool proposal). Please post only short updates here. :white_check_mark:
